sentence: This project tries to make two semiconductor quantum dots sit side by side and interact so that they can act as a two-qubit gate.
This project builds a lab manual of low-cost experiments that teach chipmaking methods without expensive cleanrooms or fabrication equipment.
This project studies fossils and DNA from cave deposits in a rainforest to find out how dwarf hippopotamuses and other animals died out.
This project studies where metabolites build up and move in the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana soon after it senses stress.
This project builds a dataset of real network activity from scientific applications so researchers can detect abnormal or malicious activity.
This project studies mathematical models for designing freeform lenses that direct light in a controlled and efficient way.
This project builds a cloud lab where AI agents and robots run experiments on their own to discover materials inspired by biological design.
This project brings together scientists who use yeast to study how chromosomes are duplicated and how cells control their growth and division.
This project measures carbon isotopes in ocean water samples collected on ship cruises to learn how human-caused carbon moves through the ocean.
This project supports a conference where researchers share techniques and tools for making computer hardware secure.
This project builds a fire weather planning tool to help communities plan and carry out prescribed burns safely.
This project builds a question answering system that reads time series data and text together and explains its answers.
This project tries to build single-photon detectors from iron-based superconductors that work at higher temperatures than current detectors.
This project studies how glowworm larvae change their behavior, glue and genes when prey is scarce, and whether offspring inherit those changes.
This project develops courses that teach technicians how to use 3D metal printing and quality control in metal additive manufacturing.
This project builds a deep learning system that detects abnormal behavior in surveillance video in real time without identifying people.
